fair_access: a declared User-Agent, one request at a time and at most 2 requests per second (52 capture requests, no key)
seeded_objects: exchange rates for ten currencies, average interest rates on Treasury securities, Treasury-owned gold by facility, interest expense, Title XII advances for two states, agency net cost, Daily Treasury Statement cash and agency deposits/withdrawals, five sets of securities auctions, revenue collections, Monthly Treasury Statement outlays for three departments, savings bond sales, maturity rates, debt to the penny and receivables for two departments
licence: U.S. public domain (works of the U.S. Government); the API needs no key or login

notes: the first record is the page navigation to debt_outstanding (a JSON document), the other 51 are in-page fetches
the API sets load-balancer cookies; scope_har.py removes all cookies and headers except content-type/accept
